Our Services

Career Guidance

Graduating from university with a degree is a significant accomplishment that deserves enthusiastic congratulations. However, the world has evolved, making the transition from education to a thriving career more competitive than ever before. In the UK, for example, more than 400,000 new graduates enter the job market each year, with over 70% earning a 2.1 or First Class degree. Given this high level of competition, Career guidance counseling has become as essential as academic tutoring or sports coaching. It can provide graduates with the guidance and strategies needed to reach their full potential and secure a competitive advantage in the job market.

Most universities in the UK now appoint career guidance counsellors to support their graduates in the job search process. This initiative complements the efforts of inviting big businesses to job fairs and seminars, providing prospective job seekers with valuable networking opportunities and insights. In a world that has significantly evolved, career guidance counsellors play a crucial role in navigating the competitive job market. They offer tailored advice, resources, and strategies to help graduates stand out and succeed in their chosen careers.

Comprehensive coaching and resources for exams like GRE, GMAT, TOEFL, and IELTS to ensure you meet entry requirements.

08

Full guidance and support throughout the visa application process to ensure a smooth transition.

Visa Application Process

As a visa application service provider using Find my career have the capabilities and knowhow to successfully apply for visas using its 17 years of experience. We are up to date with our knowledge and information in an ever evolving environment. Our experienced staff will be engaged in…

1. Document Preparation: We will be involved in the gathering and preparing of necessary documents for the visa application. This may include application forms, passports, photographs, financial documents, travel itineraries, and other supporting materials.
2. Application Submission: We will submit the visa application on behalf of the applicant to the consulate or embassy. This may involve scheduling appointments, if necessary, and ensuring that all documents are submitted.
VISA

We offer a wide range of services tailored to meet the unique needs of each student:

  • University Selection: We help students identify the best-fit universities based on their academic background, career goals, and personal preferences.
  • Application Assistance: From completing application forms to writing personal statements, we provide comprehensive support to ensure every application is strong and competitive.
  • Test Preparation: Our test prep services cover all major standardized tests required for graduate admissions, including GRE, GMAT, TOEFL, and IELTS.
  • Visa Guidance: Navigating the visa application process can be daunting. Our experts offer step-by-step guidance to ensure a smooth and successful visa application.
  • Pre-Departure Services: We provide valuable information and resources to help students prepare for their transition to studying abroad, including cultural orientation, accommodation assistance, and travel arrangements.
